ྈrdo rje phag mo'i gsang ba'i sgrub pa bzhugs so:

tei:div.tei:p: "!#ྈ rdo rje phag mo'i gsang ba'i sgrub pa bzhugs so:
ྈྈྈྈྈྈ ྈ ྈ dus gsum rgyal ba skyed pa'i yum: mkha' 'gro kun gyi gtso mo ste: byin rlabs dngos grub dbang gi bdag: rdo rje phag mo'i sku la bstod:

bdag 'dra pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis: phyi rabs rnal 'byor don ched du: rdo rje phag mo'i gsang sgrub 'di: zil chen gsang ba'i phug pa ru: ye shes mtsho rgyal ma la bshad: 'di nyid nyams su blangs gyur na: khams gsum ma lus dbang sdud cing: 'ja' lus mkha' spyod 'grub par 'gyur: nyams su blang ba'i rim pa ni: maṇ+ḍal mda' gang gru bzhi la: mtshal dang khrag gis chag chag gdab: dngul lam gsal ba'i me long ngos: sin+dhu ra yi thig le bkod: bya rgod snying dang dri bzang spos: le brgan dar gyi nang du dril: srog sngags bris te lus la bcang: sman gtor rak+ta mchod rdzas bsham: rkang gling rol mo'i sgra yis bskul: khyad par ltag sprod rnga brdungs nas: ma yengs ngang du 'di ltar bskyed:

bh+yo: sgyu lus sha khrag phung po 'di: dmigs med 'ja' ltar yal nas kyang: rang sems ma 'gags rig rtsal ni: sku gsum lhun grub pad+ma 'byung: dkar dmar mdangs ldan zhi ma khro: rdo rje thod pa kha ṭ+wāṃ bsnams: pad zhwa chos gos sham thabs gsol: snang srid zil gnon tshul du gsal:
de nas bdag mdun dbyer med pas: rdo rje phag mo 'di ltar bsgom:

bh+yo: 'khor 'das snang srid stong pa la: kun khyab sems kyi cho 'phrul gyis: stong gsal ma 'gags dkyil 'khor shar: dur khrod chen po 'jigs su rung: mi ro keng rus rdza ltar 'khrol: khrag gi zham chu phyogs bzhir 'bab: ro dri bsnams shing dur shing bskyod: bya dang gcan gzan rgyug 'dral byed: de dbus 'od lnga'i gzhal yas khang: mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs: pad 'dab phyi nang mu khyud ldan: 'khor yug dur khrod brgyad kyis bskor: dbus lter 'ja' tshon sna lnga'i gur: gsal 'tsher thig le'i dkyil 'khor du: thabs shes nyi zla 'od zer 'bar: bdag med bam ro bsnol ba'i khrir: hūm̐ las ye shes mkha' 'gro ma: rdo rje phag mo sku mdog dmar: bcu drug lon pa'i na tshod ldan: lang tsho dar la bab pa mo: zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum ma: rked pa sgeg la nu ma 'bur: zhal gdangs mche ba cung zad gtsigs: dbu skra dmar ser gyen thur bskyod: spyi gtsug phag zhal ngur sgra sgrog: thod skam lnga yis dbu la brgyan: rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal byas: rin chen rus pa'i rgyan drug gsol: mi lpags g.yang gzhi'i stod g.yogs dang: gzig lpags rlon pa'i sham thabs dkris: dar sna lnga yi cod pan bskyod: phyag gdub zhabs gdub dril bu 'khrol: gser gyi snyan cha mgul rgyan dang: me long sna lngas mdzes par byas: phyag g.yas gri gug nam mkhar gdengs:

g.yon pas thod khrag thugs kar bskyil: kha ṭ+wāṃ rtse gsum gru la brten: g.yas bskum rting pas 'og phyogs mnan: g.yon brkyang ro yi snying gar brdzis: hūm̐ dang pheṃ gyis sgra chen sgrog: rkang pa rdo rje'i sgeg 'gros can: thogs med mkha' la bun ne bun: lag pa gser gyi gdu bu can: sna tshogs gar stabs khyugs se khyug: cha lugs rnam pa sna tshogs 'gyed: 'od zer 'ja' tshon sna lnga shar: phrin las rnam bzhi lhun gyis grub: sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro 'bum gyis bskor: bh+yo: shar du rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma: sku mdog dkar mo gzi brjid can: bcu drug lon pa'i na tshod ldan: lang tsho dar la babs pa mo: zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum ma: sked pa sgeg la nu ma 'bur: thod skam lnga yis dbu la brgyan: rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal can: mi lpags g.yang gzhi'i stod g.yogs dang: gzig gi pags pa'i sham thabs dkris: dar dang rus pa'i rgyan drug bklubs: phyag gnyis gri gug thod khrag 'dzin: zhabs gnyis brkyang bskum gar stabs mdzad: kha ṭ+wāṃ rtse gsum dku la brten: rkang pa rdo rje'i sgeg 'gros can: thogs med mkha' la bun ne bun: lag pa gser gyi gdu bu can: sna tshogs gar stabs khyugs se khyug: cha lugs rnam pa sna tshogs 'gyed: 'od zer 'ja' tshon dkar po shar: zhi ba'i phrin las lhun gyis grub: rdo rje mkha' 'gro 'bum gyis bskor: bh+yo:

lho ru rin chen mkha' 'gro ma: sku mdog ser mo gzi brjid can: bcu drug lon pa'i na tshod ldan: lang tsho dar la babs pa mo: zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum ma: sked pa sgeg la nu ma 'bur: thod skam lnga yi dbu rgyan dang: rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal byas: mi lpags g.yang gzhi'i stod g.yogs dang: gzig gi pags pa'i sham thabs dkris: dar dang rus pa'i rgyan drug bklubs: phyag gnyis gri gug thod khrag 'dzin: zhabs gnyis brkyang bskum gar stabs mdzad: kha ṭ+wāṃ rtse gsum dku la brten: rkang pa rdo rje'i sgeg 'gros can: thogs med mkha' la bun ne bun: lag pa gser gyi gdu bu can: sna tshogs gar stabs khyugs se khyug: cha lugs rnam pa sna tshogs 'gyed: 'od zer 'ja' tshon ser po shar: rgyas pa'i phrin las lhun gyis grub: rin chen mkha' 'gro 'bum gyis bskor: bh+yo: nub phyogs pad+ma mkha' 'gro ma: sku mdog dmar mo gzi brjid can: bcu drug lon pa'i na tshod ldan: lang tsho dar la babs pa mo: zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum ma: sked pa sgeg la nu ma 'bur: thod skam lnga yi dbu rgyan dang: rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal byas: mi lpags g.yang gzhi'i stod g.yogs dang: gzig gi pags pa'i sham thabs dkris: dar dang rus pa'i rgyan drug bklubs: phyag gnyis gri gug thod khrag 'dzin: zhabs gnyis brkyang bskum gar stabs mdzad: kha ṭ+wāṃ rtse gsum dku la brten:

rkang pa rdo rje'i sgeg 'gros can: thogs med mkha' la bun ne bun: lag pa gser gyi gdu bu can: sna tshogs gar stabs khyugs se khyug: cha lugs rnam pa sna tshogs 'gyed: 'od zer 'ja' tshon dmar po shar: dbang gi phrin las lhun gyis grub: pad+ma mkha' 'gro 'bum gyis bskor: bh+yo: byang phyogs las kyi mkha' 'gro ma: sku mdog ljang mo gzi brjid can: bcu drug lon pa'i na tshod ldan: lang tsho dar la babs pa mo: zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum ma: sked pa sgeg la nu ma 'bur: thod skam lnga yi dbu rgyan dang: thod rlon lnga bcu'i do shal byas: mi lpags g.yang gzhi'i stod g.yogs dang: gzig gi pags pa'i sham thabs dkris: dar dang rus pa'i rgyan drug bklubs: phyag gnyis gri gug thod khrag 'dzin: zhabs gnyis brkyang bskum gar stabs mdzad: kha ṭ+wāṃ rtse gsum dku la brten: rkang pa rdo rje'i sgeg 'gros can: thogs med mkha' la bun ne bun: lag pa gser gyi gdu bu can: sna tshogs gar stabs khyugs se khyug: cha lugs rnam pa sna tshogs 'gyed: 'od zer 'ja' tshon ljang gu shar: drag po'i phrin las lhun gyis grub: las kyi mkha' 'gro 'bum gyis bskor: bh+yo: shar sgor mkha' 'gro khra gdong ma: sku mdog dkar mo lcags kyu 'dzin: lho sgor mkha' 'gro phag gdong ma: sku mdog ser mo zhags pa 'dzin: nub sgor mkha' 'gro khyi gdong ma: sku mdog dmar mo lcags sgrog 'dzin:

byang sgor mkha' 'gro 'ug gdong ma: sku mdog ljang mo dril bu 'dzin: kun kyang khro gtum rngams shing brjid: dur khrod rus pa'i rgyan drug gsol: phyi rim bar khyams khor yug la: dkar mo 'bum dang ser mo 'bum: dmar mo 'bum dang ljang mo 'bum: ye shes 'bum dang 'jig rten 'bum: las byed 'bum dang shugs 'gro 'bum: sha za 'bum dang dman mo 'bum: kun kyang cha lugs sna tshogs 'chang: 'jig rten khams kun g.yo bar byed: snang srid 'khor 'das 'jigs par byed: ri rab rming nas sgyel bar byed: ri bran tshog por 'phen par byed: nyi zla cha lang rdeb par byed: gnam sa steng 'og sgyur bar byed: mtshon cha rno ba'i 'khor lo bskor: khrag gi char pa dmar po 'beb: thog dang ser ba'i bu yug 'tshubs: mi lpags g.yang gzhi'i g.yab mo rdeb: tshil chen dud pa sprin ltar gtibs: mi rkang gling bu 'brug ltar sgrog: 'ja' 'od thig les 'jig rten khengs: gsang ba mkha' 'gro'i lha tshogs rnams: snang stong zung 'jug chu zla ltar: ma 'dres yongs rdzogs ngang nyid du: 'bad med gzi brjid chen por gsal: hrīḥḍā ki nī badz+ra bha ra hi ha ri ni sa tsit+ta badz+ra sa ma ya ma bh+yo dzaḥsid+dhi pha la hūm̐: sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra sa ma ya dza: dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho:
de nas ye shes pa spyan 'dren ni: spos dang sha chen tshil chen bsreg: dbyangs snyan rol mo'i sgra yis bskul: ma yengs ngang du 'di skad do:

bh+yo: o rgyan mkha' spyod zhing khams nas: gsang sngags ma rgyud mkha' 'gro'i tshogs: rang bzhin gnas nas skur bzhengs la: skad cig nyid la 'dir gshegs shig: bh+yo: gsang ba mchog gi dur khrod nas: mkha' 'gro'i gtso mo phag zhal can: 'khor tshogs sprul pa'i mkha' 'gro 'bum: yang sprul bye ba sa ya rnams: skad cig nyid la 'dir gshegs shig: bsil ba tshal gyi dur khrod nas: rdo rje mkha' 'gro gshegs su gsol: gad rgyangs sgrog pa'i dur khrod nas: rin chen mkha' 'gro gshegs su gsol: pad+ma 'khyil ba'i dur khrod nas: pad+ma mkha' 'gro gshegs su gsol: kī la ya yi dur khrod nas: las kyi mkha' 'gro gshegs su gsol: gzhan yang sgo srung mkha' 'gro dang: sha za zhing skyong shugs 'gro sogs: rang rang sprul pa bye ba 'bum: skad cig nyid la 'dir gshegs shig: bh+yo: sku yi rigs kyi mkha' 'gro ma: dkar mo 'bum sde gshegs su gsol: gsung gi rigs kyi mkha' 'gro ma: dmar mo 'bum sde gshegs su gsol: thugs kyi rigs kyi mkha' 'gro ma: nag mo 'bum sde gshegs su gsol: yon tan rigs kyi mkha' 'gro ma: ser mo 'bum sde gshegs su gsol: phrin las rigs kyi mkha' 'gro ma: ljang mo 'bum sde gshegs su gsol: gnas dang yul gyi zhing khams nas: ye shes dang ni las las grub: mkha' 'gro bye ba sa ya'i tshogs: 'khor dang bcas pa ma lus kun: bdag gi dad pas spyan 'dren na:

thugs dam dbang gis gshegs su gsol: bh+yo: ma rgyud mkha' 'gro'i lha tshogs rnams: mkha' spyod gnas nas gshegs tsa na: gar dang stangs stabs khyugs se khyug: gsang ba'i glu len kyu ru ru: zhing chen ḍā ru khro lo lo: rus pa'i rgyan cha khra la la: mi rkang gling bu tse re re: mi lpags g.yang gzhi lhubs se lhub: zhun chen mar me ta la la: mi gsur dud pa phyu ru ru: mi mgo'i phreng ba khrigs se khrig: zhing chen g.yab mo lings se ling: g.yu yi na bun thibs se thib: shel gyi khu 'phang hri li li: gser gyi nyi ma kyi li li: dung gi zla ba sga ra ra: dar gyi cod pan pu ru ru: rnga dung rol mo ldi ri ri: sha rus don snying nyi li li: ral pa'i thor tshugs ldems se ldem: phyag gdub zhabs gdub si li li: ha sgra bso sgra ti ri ri: stong gsum kun kyang shigs se shig: gnam sa kun kyang 'u ru ru: lha srin sde brgyad sha ra ra: rigs drug sems can nyi li li: stong gsum 'jig rten 'chol zhing 'khrugs: gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: byin chen phob la dbang chen skur: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol:
de nas bzhugs su gsol ba ni:

bh+yo: 'dir bshams 'bar ba'i gnas mchog ni: pad+ma ge sar chags pa med: nyi zla'i 'od mdangs ma rig 'joms: rtog med bam ro'i khri steng du: mkha' 'gro 'khor bcas bzhugs nas kyang: sgrub pa'i bu la gzigs su gsol: lam gyi bar chad zhi ba dang: khams gsum dbang sdud dngos grub stsol:
de nas gus pas phyag 'tshal te:
e ma ho: bde ba chen po'i ngo bo nyid: pha rol phyin drug rang bzhin can: rdo rje phag mo 'khor bcas la: bdag nyid gus pas thal mo sbyar:
de nas mchod pa 'bul ba ni:

ho: mdzes shing yid 'ong me tog phreng: bzang po'i dri ldan lha rdzas spos: ma rig mun sel gsal ba'i me: sman dang sbyar ba'i dri chab chu: ro brgya ldan pa'i 'bru bcud zan: yan lag brgyad ldan rol mo'i sgra: ma rgyud mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la 'bul: brtse ba chen pos bzhes su gsol: ho: gzugs dang sgra dang dri dang ro: reg dang 'dod yon lnga la sogs: nang gi mchod pa dam pa 'di: ma rgyud mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la 'bul: ho: dbang po'i me tog gsur chen dri: zhun chen mar me khrag gi chab: sha rus zhal zas rkang gling sgra: shin tu gsang ba'i mchod pa 'bul: ho: bdud rtsi sman dang rak+ta dmar: ba liṃ gtor ma myos byed chang: sha sna snying sna khrag sna'i tshogs: ma rgyud mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la 'bul: rus pa'i rgyan dang zhing lpags gos: bhan+dha'i skyogs dang bam ro'i khri: keng rus khang bzang skra yi g.yab: g.yang gzhi'i gdugs dang tsit+ta'i tog: rus chen drwa ba drwa phyed 'phyang: dur khrod bkod pa'i yul ljongs 'di: ma rgyud mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la 'bul: brtse ba chen pos bzhes su gsol: hrīḥm ha ri ni sa ar+ghaṃ puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai bid+ya shab+da pū dza ho: rū pa shab+da gan+dhe ra sa spar+she pū dza ho: sarba pañtsa a mṛta ba liṃ ta rak+ta la khā hi: ma hā māṃ sa la khā hi: ma hā tsit+ta la khā hi: ma hā rak+ta la khā hi: ma hā ba su ta la khā hi:
ma hā go ro tsa na la khā hi: ma hā kiṃ ni ri ti la khā hi: sarba sid+dhi m+me pra ya ts+tshan+tu swā hā:
de nas bstod pa bya ba ni:

bh+yo: o rgyan yul gyi dur khrod nas: bcom ldan rdo rje phag mo ni: sku mdog dmar smug mdangs dang ldan: khams gsum dbang du sdud pa'i brda: zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum 'bur: sku gsum lhun gyis grub pa'i brda: zhal gdangs mche ba cung zad gtsigs: skye 'chi rtsad nas gcod pa'i brda: dkar 'dzin chu 'dzin bde ba rgyas: dngos grub sna tshogs ster ba'i brda: mnyen lcug 'khril ldem gzhon tshul ldan: bde stong rgyun chad med pa'i brda: phyag g.yas gri gug ngar ldan phyar: dug lnga rnam rtog gcod pa'i brda: g.yon pas ban+dha khrag bkang gsol: 'khor ba'i 'khor lo gzhom pa'i brda: thod skam lnga yi dbu rgyan ni: rigs lngas 'gro don mdzad pa'i brda: thod rlon lnga bcu'i do shal byas: 'du byed lnga bcu zad pa'i brda: mi lpags g.yang gzhi'i stod g.yogs gsol: 'dun 'gros sgyu mar ston pa'i brda: gzig lpags rlon pa'i sham thabs dkris: log 'dren gdug pa 'dul ba'i brda: rus pa'i rgyan drug gsol ba ni: phar phyin drug dang ldan pa'i brda: kha ṭ+wāṃ rtse gsum gru la brten: dug gsum dbyings su bsgral pa'i brda: phyag zhabs gser gyi gdu bus brgyan: phrin las rnam bzhi 'grub pa'i brda: sku la khrag zhag thig les brgyan: mi rtag rgyud la bskul ba'i brda: zhabs gnyis brkyang bskum gar stabs mdzad: 'khor ba dong nas sprugs pa'i brda:

me long dril bu 'khrol ba ni: stong gsum chos sgra sgrog pa'i brda: dar sna lnga yi cod pan bskyod: ye shes lnga dang ldan pa'i brda: hūm̐ sgra pheṃ sgra sgrog pa ni: mkha' 'gro'i dmag tshogs 'du ba'i brda: ma rgyud yongs kyi che btsan mchog: rdo rje phag mo khyod nyid la: mi phyed dad pas phyag 'tshal zhing: sgo gsum gus pas bstod par bgyi: bh+yo: ye shes dbyings kyi rang bzhin ma: sangs rgyas rigs kyi mkha' 'gro 'bum: las rnams thams cad mthar phyin mdzad: gtso mo 'bum la phyag 'tshal bstod: bh+yo: mi 'gyur rdo rje rigs kyi yum: mkha' 'gro dkar mo gzi brjid can: mi mthun phyogs kun zhi bar mdzad: dkar mo 'bum la phyag 'tshal bstod: bh+yo: 'phel byed rin chen rigs kyi yum: mkha' 'gro ser mo gzi brjid can: tshe dbang longs spyod rgyas par mdzad: ser mo 'bum la phyag 'tshal bstod: bh+yo: 'gugs byed pad+ma rigs kyi yum: mkha' 'gro dmar mo gzi brjid can: lha 'dre mi gsum dbang du sdud: dmar mo 'bum la phyag 'tshal bstod: bh+yo: sgrol byed las kyi rigs kyi yum: mkha' 'gro ljang nag gzi brjid can: dgra bgegs gtan nas brlag par mdzad: ljang mo 'bum la phyag 'tshal bstod: bh+yo: shar gyi mkha' 'gro khwa gdong ma: snying rje chen po'i lcags kyu 'dzin: mngon spyod tshul bzhin bstan pa srung: shar sgo srung mdzad khyod la bstod:

bh+yo: lho yi mkha' 'gro phag gdong ma: byams pa chen po'i zhags pa 'dzin: mngon spyod tshul bzhin bstan pa srung: lho sgo srung mdzad khyod la bstod: bh+yo: nub kyi mkha' 'gro khyi gdong ma: dga' ba chen po'i lcags sgrog 'dzin: mngon spyod tshul bzhin bstan pa srung: nub sgo srung mdzad khyod la bstod: bh+yo: byang gi mkha' 'gro 'ug gdong ma: btang snyoms chen po'i dril bu 'dzin: mngon spyod tshul bzhin bstan pa srung: byang sgo srung mdzad khyod la bstod: bh+yo: gnas dang yul gyi zhing khams nas: rang rang phrin las myur du sgrub: dkar ser dmar ljang ral pa can: ma mo mkha' 'gro shugs 'gro dang: ging chen ging chung zhing skyong tshogs: sha za dman mo phra men bcas: 'jigs gzugs rngams pa'i nga ro 'chang: bstan pa srung mdzad khyod la bstod:
de nas bshags pa bya ba ni:

ho: rigs lnga'i mkha' 'gro dgongs su gsol: bdag cag ma rig rkyen dbang gis: dam rdzas ma tshang phud nyams dang: gsang ba bsgrags dang gsang sngags smad: phyi yi dam tshig nyams pa rnams: mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la mthol bshags na: bzod par bzhes la tshangs par stsol: phrin las rnam bzhi 'grub gyur cig: ho: bskyed rim ma gsal sngags zur nyams: dam rdzas ma bsten 'byor tshogs chung: rdzogs rim ma rdzogs dred chos rtsing: nang gi dam tshig nyams pa rnams: gnong 'gyod drag po'i sems kyis ni: mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la mthol bshags na: bzod par bzhes la tshangs par stsol: phrin las rnam bzhi 'grub gyur cig: ho: thugs dam ma bskangs dus mchod g.yel: bka' lung dbang dang mi ldan zhing: bsnyen sgrub ma byas las la bskul: gsang ba'i dam tshig nyams pa rnams: gnong 'gyod drag po'i sems kyis ni: mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la mthol bshags na: bzod par bzhes la tshangs pa stsol: phrin las rnam bzhi 'grub gyur cig:
yi ge brgya pa brjod: de nas bzlas pa'i dkyil 'khor ni:

rang lus rdo rje phag mo bsgom: rtsa 'khor lnga yi nang thams cad: mkha' 'gro lnga yis khengs par dmigs: gzhan yang rtsa gnas ma lus kun: mkha' 'gro til gyi gong bu ltar: dpag tu med pas khengs nas ni: gsang sngags rang sgra sgrog par dmigs: snying gar pad+ma 'dab bzhi la: gsang ba thugs kyi phag mo lnga: gcer bu rgyan med gri thod 'dzin: brkyang bskum gar gyi rol par bzhugs: sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro'i thugs ka ru: oṃ āḥhūm̐ gi yi ge bsgom: mtha' mar sngags phreng bskor ba'i sgras: mtsho la char babs ji bzhin du: rang la sib sib thim par dmigs: mkha' 'gro rnams kyi gsang gnas nas: 'od dmar lcags kyu'i dbyibs can 'phros: 'byung ba'i bcud dang skye 'gro'i tshe: dpal 'byor longs spyod dbang du bsdus: rang gi gsang bar thim par bsam: phag zhal ngur sgra sgrog pa yis: rgyal ba zhi khro ma lus kun: 'ur 'ur shig shig byas nas su: skad cig nyid la gshegs gyur cing: spyi bo'i gtsug nas mar la thim: sku gsung thugs kyis byin brlabs te: sku bzhi'i dbang mchog thob par
bsam: srog sngags chu yi rgyun ltar bzlas:
hrīḥḍā ki nī badz+ra bha ra hi ha ri ni sa tsit+ta badz+ra sa ma ya ma bh+yo dzaḥsid+dhi pha la hūm̐:

'bum phrag gcig gis 'grub par 'gyur: nyams snang rmi lam snang yul du: bud med 'du zhing gsang rtags ston: bdud rtsi chang dang 'o ma sogs: mkha' 'gro rnams kyis rang la 'thor: me tog sngon po'i phreng ba dang: me long rkang gling ḍā ru dril: rang gi lus la 'dogs pa sogs: phyi yi rtags rnams 'byung bar 'gyur: dngos su bya rgod dri ma 'thul: sna bug g.yon nas rak+ta 'bab: ba spu g.yo zhing bde ba rgyas: rig pa gsal zhing mgur dbyangs 'dod: de ni nang gi 'grub rtags yin: mthu dang byin rlabs bsam mi khyab: khams gsum ma lus rang la 'du: tshe ring longs spyod char ltar 'beb: de ni gsang ba'i 'grub rtags yin: phrin las bzhi sbyor 'di lta ste: rnal 'byor dam ldan 'ga' zhig gis: mi mthun phyogs kun zhi 'dod na: srog sngags sham bur 'di ltar sbyar:
sarba duṣ+ṭāṃ shān+tiṃ ku ru ye swā hā:
yungs dkar bsngags nas lus la bcang: tshe dang longs spyod rgyas 'dod na: srog sngags sham bur 'di ltar sbyar:
ā yuḥpuṇ+ye puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru ye swā hā:
rin chen 'bru sna bsngags nas 'chang: khams gsum dbang du bsgyur 'dod na: srog sngags sham bur 'di ltar sbyar:
khams gsum srid gsum wa shaṃ ku ru swā hā:
pha waṃ long bu bsngags nas 'chang: gdug pa'i dgra bgegs brlag 'dod na: srog sngags sham bur 'di ltar sbyar:
sarba sha trūṃ mā ra ya phaṭa:
lcags kyi phur bur bsngags nas 'chang: pha rol rbod gtong bzlog 'dod na: srog sngags sham bur 'di ltar bya:
e sa bh+yo zlog: ki sa bh+yo zlog: man+t+ra beṅga bh+yo zlog:
bya rog sha khrag bsngags nas 'chang: mtshon cha rno ba'i kha bsrung na: srog sngags sham bur 'di ltar sbyar:
si li si li phaṭa: mtshon gyi ngar zhi: rnon po mdun dig: mgar ba'i ha log:
nas nag mtshon gyis ma bcad sngags: lto ru btang ste bud med spang: sbyar dug nag po bsrung 'dod na: srog sngags sham bur 'di ltar sbyar:
ka ro hriṃ hrīṃ: nan gyi sod: sod gyi nan:
rma bya'i sgang thur bsngags nas 'chang: rgya nad rgyug gzer bsrung 'dod na: srog sngags sham bur 'di ltar sbyar:
nag po thuṃ ril sod: rgyug gzer nag po a rbad sod:
dgu sbyor yungs 'bru bdun la sngags/ kha ru zos shing sha chang bsrung: nam mkha'i gnam lcags bsrung 'dod na: srog sngags sham bur 'di ltar sbyar:
nā ga phu raṃ rbad: ha la ha la phyung: pra ma pra ma shig: ka la rak+sha thi thun:

khyung lnga ldong ros bsngags nas 'chang: gang la gang dgos rig pas dpyad: brgya stong khri sogs grangs dang sbyar: las rnams thams cad 'grub par 'gyur: khyad par dbang gi las rnams 'grub: sa ma ya kha thaṃ: zab rgya: gnyan rgya: gtad rgya: de nas bskul zhing phrin las bcol:
